research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Short sentence change
verified_claims: The population serving six months or less fell by 1%, while the population serving more than six months to less than 12 months rose by 2%.
limitations: These bands are custody measures and cannot produce parcel-level candidates.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Sentenced offence mix
verified_claims: Around seven in ten prisoners serving an immediate custodial sentence had been convicted of violence against the person, sexual, or drug offences.
limitations: National offence composition is not a local incident count or risk estimate.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Extended determinate sentences
verified_claims: There were 9,532 prisoners serving extended determinate sentences on 31 March 2026, up 8% from March 2025.
limitations: EDS totals are institutional statistics and not location-level evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Unreleased indeterminate population
verified_claims: There were 8,486 unreleased prisoners serving indeterminate sentences, comprising 8,120 males and 366 females.
limitations: The aggregate does not support inference about a neighbourhood or parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Unreleased life sentences
verified_claims: The number of unreleased prisoners serving life sentences was 7,590, up 1% from a year earlier.
limitations: The statistic is national and cannot be spatially assigned to property risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Unreleased IPP prisoners
verified_claims: The number of unreleased IPP prisoners fell by 11% to 896.
limitations: The figure does not identify where offences occurred or future local risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Recalled life and IPP prisoners
verified_claims: Recalled life-sentence prisoners increased by 3% to 893, while recalled IPP prisoners decreased by 6% to 1,433.
limitations: Recall status is not parcel-level evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Population recalled to custody
verified_claims: The population recalled to custody was 12,089, down 11% from a year earlier.
limitations: A custody recall total cannot be treated as a neighbourhood safety indicator.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Foreign national prison population
verified_claims: There were 10,487 foreign nationals in custody on 31 March 2026, representing 12% of the total and 3% fewer than a year earlier.
limitations: Nationality data must not be used to infer danger from individuals, communities, or locations.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Foreign national composition
verified_claims: The most common nationalities after British nationals were Albanian, Irish, Polish, Romanian, and Indian.
limitations: Nationality composition is descriptive only and is prohibited from parcel or person-level risk inference.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual first receptions
verified_claims: There were 75,578 first receptions into custody in 2025, a 3% increase from 2024.
limitations: Custody inflow is a national service measure, not a local crime count.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: First reception trend
verified_claims: Annual first receptions reached a low of 59,440 in 2021 and increased to 75,578 in 2025.
limitations: A long-run national trend cannot be attributed to a property.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Reception sentence-band growth
verified_claims: Sentenced first receptions for sentences over six months and under 12 months increased by 43% compared with 2024.
limitations: The increase reflects sentencing and reception flows, not parcel exposure.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Foreign national reception share
verified_claims: Around 18% of first prison receptions in 2025 were foreign nationals.
limitations: The share is descriptive and cannot support discriminatory or geographic risk inference.
